subtitulo: Purpose, length and accommodation at Mexican immigration — short, true and supported
frasePiso: Answer the question that was asked; the reservation carries the rest.

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Mexican immigration determines the traveller's authorised period of stay at entry; visa-free tourism does not automatically grant 180 days.
fatosDatados.fonte: Instituto Nacional de Migración; U.S. Department of State — Mexico entry and exit procedures

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Immigration may request hotel booking, return tickets, itinerary, address, intended length of stay and personal information to corroborate the purpose of the trip.
fatosDatados.fonte: Instituto Nacional de Migración — Países y regiones que no requieren visa

steps.pt: The immigration desk is not a Spanish exam and it is not the place to improve your story. The officer determines the period you are authorised to stay. Listen for three jobs only: why you came, how long you will stay and where you will sleep. Give the true answer, then stop.

steps.es: ¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?
steps.pt: What is the purpose of your trip?
steps.tts: ¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?

steps.promptPt: The officer asks the purpose of the trip. You are travelling for a holiday. Answer in one sentence. Speak now.

steps.pt: How many days are you staying?
Use your real number. Ten days is the rehearsal value, not a line to memorise for every trip. Immigration can corroborate the length and purpose with your booking, return ticket or itinerary.

steps.promptPt: Your actual itinerary is ten days. Give only the duration. Speak now.

steps.pt: The accommodation answer is not the story of how you found the hotel. Name the category and let the saved reservation hold the address.

steps.promptPt: The officer asks where you will stay. Your confirmed accommodation is the hotel shown in your offline reservation. Answer briefly. Speak now.
steps.pt: I am staying at this hotel.

steps.promptPt: The officer asks for proof. Hand over the offline confirmation without adding a speech. Speak now.

steps.es: Vengo de vacaciones. Diez días. Me hospedo en este hotel.
steps.pinyin: BEN-goh deh bah-kah-SYOH-nehs. DYEHS DEE-ahs. meh ohs-PEH-doh en EHS-teh oh-TEL
steps.pt: Shadow the three answers with a clean stop after each one.
steps.tts: Vengo de vacaciones. Diez días. Me hospedo en este hotel.

steps.pt: B05 complete. Purpose: vacation. Duration: your real number. Accommodation: the place on your confirmed booking. If proof is requested, hand it over. Short does not mean evasive; short means the answer matches the question.

aprofundar.titulo: The border is a matching task

secoes.corpo: Never copy the lesson's ten days when your itinerary says something else. Replace the number with the truth; the structure stays short.
Purpose, duration and accommodation are separate payloads. Do not stack all three unless the officer asks for them together.
When proof is requested, Aquí tiene mi reservación moves the exchange from memory to evidence.
Entry procedure and authorised-stay rules can change. Recheck official INM and consular guidance before departure.
